sql_query.query: SELECT p.id, p.cycle, p.recipient_id, u.name AS recipient_name, p.amount, p.status, p.recorded_by, p.created_at FROM _payouts p JOIN _users u ON u.id = p.recipient_id WHERE p.circle_id = $1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _memberships m WHERE m.circle_id = $1 AND m.user_id = $2) ORDER BY p.cycle DESC
